title: Only Office User and Time Clock User are non-editable; every other system role (including Administrator) is editable
preconds: 1. You are logged in as an admin on the Roles & Permissions list with all system roles visible.
steps:
1. Look at the Actions for each system role: Administrator, Service Manager, Senior Service Advisor, Service Advisor, Foreman, Technician, Parts Manager, Parts Technician, Office User, Sales Representative, Time Clock User.
  2. For Office User and Time Clock User, confirm the lock icon and eye-only action.
  3. For the others, confirm a pencil (edit) is available.
expected:
Only Office User and Time Clock User are non-editable (lock icon, eye/View Permissions only).

Every other system role — including Administrator — is editable (pencil available).

No system role can be deleted.
